name: GPPO Interposer Workflow
description: Validate workbook connectivity and reconcile approved GPPO artifacts in a project copy
description_full: Native KiCad workflow for authoritative workbook import, source-row inspection, copper-layer permissions, independent gang placement, approved read-only footprint and RF artifact selection, DXF circle anchors, optional managed board outlines, deterministic schematic and BOM generation, reviewed reconciliation and journal recovery. Applies to a separate controlled project copy. Footprint and RF authoring remain separate librarian tools. Initial testing release; broader live-editor recovery, generic magnetic picking and fabrication/EM qualification are outside the validated scope.
